record.bible_text: Now these <FI>are<Fi> the words<WH01697> of the letter<WH05612> that Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030> sent<WH07971><WTH8804> from Jerusalem<WH03389> unto the residue<WH03499> of the elders<WH02205> which were carried away captives<WH01473>, and to the priests<WH03548>, and to the prophets<WH05030>, and to all the people<WH05971> whom Nebuchadnezzar<WH05019> had carried away captive<WH01540><WTH8689> from Jerusalem<WH03389> to Babylon<WH0894>;

(After<WH0310> that Jeconiah<WH03204> the king<WH04428>, and the queen<WH01377>, and the eunuchs<WH05631>, the princes<WH08269> of Judah<WH03063> and Jerusalem<WH03389>, and the carpenters<WH02796>, and the smiths<WH04525>, were departed<WH03318><WTH8800> from Jerusalem<WH03389>;) <RF>eunuchs: or, chamberlains<Rf>

By the hand<WH03027> of Elasah<WH0501> the son<WH01121> of Shaphan<WH08227>, and Gemariah<WH01587> the son<WH01121> of Hilkiah<WH02518>, (whom Zedekiah<WH06667> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063> sent<WH07971><WTH8804> unto Babylon<WH0894> to Nebuchadnezzar<WH05019> king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894>) saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, unto all that are carried away captives<WH01473>, whom I have caused to be carried away<WH01540><WTH8689> from Jerusalem<WH03389> unto Babylon<WH0894>;
Build<WH01129><WTH8798> ye houses<WH01004>, and dwell<WH03427><WTH8798> <FI>in them<Fi> ; and plant<WH05193><WTH8798> gardens<WH01593>, and eat<WH0398><WTH8798> the fruit<WH06529> of them;

Take<WH03947><WTH8798> ye wives<WH0802>, and beget<WH03205><WTH8685> sons<WH01121> and daughters<WH01323>; and take<WH03947><WTH8798> wives<WH0802> for your sons<WH01121>, and give<WH05414><WTH8798> your daughters<WH01323> to husbands<WH0582>, that they may bear<WH03205><WTH8799> sons<WH01121> and daughters<WH01121>; that ye may be increased<WH07235><WTH8798> there, and not diminished<WH04591><WTH8799>.

And seek<WH01875><WTH8798> the peace<WH07965> of the city<WH05892> whither I have caused you to be carried away captives<WH01540><WTH8689>, and pray<WH06419><WTH8690> unto the LORD<WH03068> for it: for in the peace<WH07965> thereof shall ye have peace<WH07965>.<CM>

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>; Let not your prophets<WH05030> and your diviners<WH07080><WTH8802>, that <FI>be<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> of you, deceive<WH05377><WTH8686> you, neither hearken<WH08085><WTH8799> to your dreams<WH02472> which ye cause to be dreamed<WH02492><WTH8688>.
For they prophesy<WH05012><WTH8737> falsely<WH08267> unto you in my name<WH08034>: I have not sent<WH07971><WTH8804> them, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>falsely: Heb. in a lie<Rf>

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, That after<WH06310> seventy<WH07657> years<WH08141> be accomplished<WH04390><WTH8800> at Babylon<WH0894> I will visit<WH06485><WTH8799> you, and perform<WH06965><WTH8689> my good<WH02896> word<WH01697> toward you, in causing you to return<WH07725><WTH8687> to this place<WH04725>.

For I know<WH03045><WTH8804> the thoughts<WH04284> that I think<WH02803><WTH8802> toward you, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, thoughts<WH04284> of peace<WH07965>, and not of evil<WH07451>, to give<WH05414><WTH8800> you an expected<WH08615> end<WH0319>. <RF>expected...: Heb. end and expectation<Rf>
Then shall ye call<WH07121><WTH8804> upon me, and ye shall go<WH01980><WTH8804> and pray<WH06419><WTH8694> unto me, and I will hearken<WH08085><WTH8804> unto you.
And ye shall seek<WH01245><WTH8765> me, and find<WH04672><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> , when ye shall search<WH01875><WTH8799> for me with all your heart<WH03824>.

And I will be found<WH04672><WTH8738> of you, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>: and I will turn away<WH07725><WTH8804> your captivity<WH07622><WTH8675><WH07622>, and I will gather<WH06908><WTH8765> you from all the nations<WH01471>, and from all the places<WH04725> whither I have driven<WH05080><WTH8689> you, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>; and I will bring you again<WH07725><WTH8689> into the place<WH04725> whence I caused you to be carried away captive<WH01540><WTH8689>.<CM>
Because ye have said<WH0559><WTH8804>, The LORD<WH03068> hath raised us up<WH06965><WTH8689> prophets<WH05030> in Babylon<WH0894>;

<FI> Know<Fi> that thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of the king<WH04428> that sitteth<WH03427><WTH8802> upon the throne<WH03678> of David<WH01732>, and of all the people<WH05971> that dwelleth<WH03427><WTH8802> in this city<WH05892>, <FI> and<Fi> of your brethren<WH0251> that are not gone forth<WH03318><WTH8804> with you into captivity<WH01473>;

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>; Behold, I will send<WH07971><WTH8764> upon them the sword<WH02719>, the famine<WH07458>, and the pestilence<WH01698>, and will make<WH05414><WTH8804> them like vile<WH08182> figs<WH08384>, that cannot be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>, they are so evil<WH07455>.

And I will persecute<WH07291><WTH8804> them<WH0310> with the sword<WH02719>, with the famine<WH07458>, and with the pestilence<WH01698>, and will deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> them to be removed<WH02189><WTH8675><WH02113> to all the kingdoms<WH04467> of the earth<WH0776>, to be a curse<WH0423>, and an astonishment<WH08047>, and an hissing<WH08322>, and a reproach<WH02781>, among all the nations<WH01471> whither I have driven<WH05080><WTH8689> them: <RF>to be a curse: Heb. for a curse<Rf>

Because they have not hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> to my words<WH01697>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, which I sent<WH07971><WTH8804> unto them by my servants<WH05650> the prophets<WH05030>, rising up early<WH07925><WTH8687> and sending<WH07971><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi> ; but ye would not hear<WH08085><WTH8804>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> ye therefore the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>, all ye of the captivity<WH01473>, whom I have sent<WH07971><WTH8765> from Jerusalem<WH03389> to Babylon<WH0894>:

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, of Ahab<WH0256> the son<WH01121> of Kolaiah<WH06964>, and of Zedekiah<WH06667> the son<WH01121> of Maaseiah<WH04641>, which prophesy<WH05012><WTH8737> a lie<WH08267> unto you in my name<WH08034>; Behold, I will deliver<WH05414><WTH8802> them into the hand<WH03027> of Nebuchadrezzar<WH05019> king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894>; and he shall slay<WH05221><WTH8689> them before your eyes<WH05869>;

And of them shall be taken up<WH03947><WTH8795> a curse<WH07045> by all the captivity<WH01546> of Judah<WH03063> which <FI>are<Fi> in Babylon<WH0894>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, The LORD<WH03068> make<WH07760><WTH8799> thee like Zedekiah<WH06667> and like Ahab<WH0256>, whom the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> roasted<WH07033><WTH8804> in the fire<WH0784>;

Because they have committed<WH06213><WTH8804> villany<WH05039> in Israel<WH03478>, and have committed<WH06213><WTH8804> adultery<WH05003><WTH8762> with their neighbours<WH07453>' wives<WH0802>, and have spoken<WH01696><WTH8762> lying<WH08267> words<WH01697> in my name<WH08034>, which I have not commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> them; even I know<WH03045><WTH8802>, and <FI>am<Fi> a witness<WH05707>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
<FI> Thus<Fi> shalt thou also speak<WH0559><WTH8799> to Shemaiah<WH08098> the Nehelamite<WH05161>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, <RF>Nehelamite: or, dreamer<Rf>

Thus speaketh<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Because thou hast sent<WH07971><WTH8804> letters<WH05612> in thy name<WH08034> unto all the people<WH05971> that <FI>are<Fi>  at Jerusalem<WH03389>, and to Zephaniah<WH06846> the son<WH01121> of Maaseiah<WH04641> the priest<WH03548>, and to all the priests<WH03548>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

The LORD<WH03068> hath made<WH05414><WTH8804> thee priest<WH03548> in the stead of Jehoiada<WH03077> the priest<WH03548>, that ye should be officers<WH06496> in the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068>, for every man<WH0376> <FI>that is<Fi> mad<WH07696><WTH8794>, and maketh himself a prophet<WH05012><WTH8693>, that thou shouldest put<WH05414><WTH8804> him in prison<WH04115>, and in the stocks<WH06729>.
Now therefore why hast thou not reproved<WH01605><WTH8804> Jeremiah<WH03414> of Anathoth<WH06069>, which maketh himself a prophet<WH05012><WTH8693> to you?

For therefore he sent<WH07971><WTH8804> unto us <FI>in<Fi> Babylon<WH0894>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, This<WH01931> <FI>captivity is<Fi> long<WH0752>: build<WH01129><WTH8798> ye houses<WH01004>, and dwell<WH03427><WTH8798> <FI>in them<Fi> ; and plant<WH05193><WTH8798> gardens<WH01593>, and eat<WH0398><WTH8798> the fruit<WH06529> of them.
And Zephaniah<WH06846> the priest<WH03548> read<WH07121><WTH8799> this letter<WH05612> in the ears<WH0241> of Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030>.
Then came the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> unto Jeremiah<WH03414>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Send<WH07971><WTH8798> to all them of the captivity<WH01473>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> concerning Shemaiah<WH08098> the Nehelamite<WH05161>; Because that Shemaiah<WH08098> hath prophesied<WH05012><WTH8738> unto you, and I sent<WH07971><WTH8804> him not, and he caused you to trust<WH0982><WTH8686> in a lie<WH08267>:

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Behold, I will punish<WH06485><WTH8802> Shemaiah<WH08098> the Nehelamite<WH05161>, and his seed<WH02233>: he shall not have a man<WH0376> to dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> among<WH08432> this people<WH05971>; neither shall he behold<WH07200><WTH8799> the good<WH02896> that I will do<WH06213><WTH8802> for my people<WH05971>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>; because he hath taught<WH01696><WTH8765> rebellion<WH05627> against the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>rebellion: Heb. revolt<Rf><CM>
